sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - Vector 9x19 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Perfect timing, friend. If you have time, help me out with some gun customization. A major customer has placed an order for a KRISS Vector 9x19 submachine gun. He wants it to be equipped with an Mk.5 Modular Rail mount, Tactical Dynamics Skeletonized Foregrip, some iron sights or a scope with at least 300 meter sighting range, magazine with at least 33 rounds, and a silencer. Ergonomics over 48 and recoil under 240. Thanks!"

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 22 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify a KRISS Vector 9x19 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +11,600 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.02
- 500 Dollars
  - 525 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 575 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× SureFire SOCOM556-MINI MONSTER 5.56x45 sound suppressor
- Unlocks purchase of Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle (variant SAI ) at Ref LL2
"You know, I prefer forty-five personally, but a Vector is a Vector! What a beautiful beast."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
KRISS Vector 9x19 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 48 or more ergonomics
- 240 or less recoil
- 300 or greater sighting range
- A silencer
- KRISS Vector Mk.5 modular rail
- Tactical Dynamics Skeletonized Foregrip
- Glock 9x19 "Big Stick" 33-round magazine

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard KRISS Vector 9x19 from Skier LL3.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
